products.name: Staff Pick - Meats, Cheeses & Antipasti
products.tagline: You choose how many people, we do the rest!
products.description:
We have fantastic, passionate staff members working in our deli. This is your opportunity to trust them to choose what they are excited about. Just tell us how many people, and we will do the rest. What arrives will be a thoughtfully chosen selection of meats, cheeses & antipasti for the number of people you specify. The items themselves may or may not be offered elsewhere on the site, this is your chance to get whatever our staff feels is the best right now! If you have a strong aversion to certain types of cheese or charcuterie, this might not be your best choice. If you love everything in our deli and trust us enough to choose, we're ready to put it together!

*Please leave a note in the comment box during checkout if you need this plated on a compostable platter for an additional $25 fee. We need at least 24 hours notice. Limited availability for plating service during the holidays.

products.name: Staff Pick - Blue Cheese
products.tagline: You choose the texture & the flavor, we'll choose the cheese!
products.description: If you are reading this, you like blue cheese. Well, we do too! Here's all you do: just choose the texture, flavor & the amount and we'll do the rest! Based on your answers, we'll choose a cheese that we love and that fits your criteria - couldn't be easier! It's just like standing in front of the cheese case! Feel free to add any specifics in the Instructions/Additions field at checkout. The published price per lb is only a place holder - the exact price of the cheese will be determined by the amount selected and the actual price per lb of the cheese selected

products.name: Staff Pick - Just Cheese
products.tagline: You choose how many people, we choose great cheese for you to enjoy!
products.description:
Do you trust our staff? Feeling adventurous? Choosing this option is another way of saying yes! It's easy - just tell us how many people and we will select a great variety of cheeses that complement one another in the appropriate quantities.

2 to 4 people - 3 cheeses

5 to 8 people - 4 cheeses

9 to 12 people - 5 cheeses

Cow, goat, sheep, firm, creamy, cakey...it's on on the table. This is your chance to get the cheeses that are in the best condition that our staff is most excited about right now! What you receive may or may not be offered elsewhere on the site, but you can trust that it will be great!

*Please leave a note in the comment box during checkout if you need this plated on a compostable platter for an additional $25 fee. We need at least 24 hours notice.*

*We will not be accepting plated platter orders from November 18-December 31*
